QUOTE: "`schema`, index older than server: call `index(action='refresh', force=True)`. ... `code`: a rebuild cannot clear this. Reads are still correct because the DB is opened per call. Writes are refused, and `force` does not override the refusal"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says data needs a refresh and code can't be cleared by a rebuild, but it never says that code needs a client restart. It also never says that this difference is why a single flag wouldn't be enough.
